data.title: Sterling Digital sees significant milestone as West Texas ramps up
data.description: Sterling Digital Plc (AQSE:ASIC) told investors it estimates it spent about US$19,400 on energy for each Bitcoin it mined during the initial operating period at its West Texas site. It comes after the startup of the site and the successfull mining of two Bitcoins. The site began full operations...
